source.source_beta: beta_baseline_v1.pairs.csv.gz source-locked PR118; 239 fixed butterflies, 369 level3 regions

geography.primary_mask: Lenzner crosswalk coverage>=0.8 and <=1.05, numeric climate, accepted region in butterfly beta
geography.allowed_crosswalk_target_regions: 284 or fewer only if matched GloNAF alien flora zero
geography.source_site_assign_primary: source polygon intersects at least 50% of source polygon OR at least 5% of target polygon, after EPSG:6933 equal-area
geography.source_flora_union: deduplicated set of source GloNAF recorded naturalized alien species on source regions passing polygon threshold

exposure.metric: log1p(sum min(durationA,durationB) per empire if both >=25)

endpoints.name: H1_plant_positive_control
endpoints.outcome: same WGSRPD3 GloNAF alien plant Jaccard
endpoints.controls: distance, same level1, temperature/aridity differences, native WCVP plant Jaccard, source native plant richness min/max

endpoints.name: H1_plant_strict
endpoints.controls: above plus change in general WCVP plant similarity

endpoints.name: H2_consumer
endpoints.outcome: same-284 WGSRPD3 butterfly potential-resource Jaccard change
endpoints.controls: same plus native butterfly-resource Jaccard, general WCVP plant similarity change

endpoints.name: H3_plant_resource
endpoints.controls: geography/climate + native flora/resource + general WCVP flora delta + colonial exposure

null.shuffle: whole 4 empire duration vectors per region within WGSRPD level1, stable joined support and responses
null.stat: rank partial correlation; exploratory node permutation tail

caution: Both plants and consumers reflect WCVP/HOSTS/GloNAF current catalogs, not dates of historical introduction
No direct island port shipping or true butterfly arrival
Region pairs share nodes; not iid
Positive GloNAF study is previously published, not original butterfly discovery
Same 284 WGSRPD3 region support crucial for cross-response comparison, but responses differ as level vs change
